prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence for specific kinds of changes remains thin, as every category currently has only one test.
Predictions were mostly too high, except in rounds 5 and 7 where effects were underpredicted.
Adding a new screen during pet adoption (adoption, new_screen) was helpful and won.
Redesigning the finish step (finish, redesign) significantly hurt performance.
No clear effect was seen for reordering sign-in steps (sign_in, reorder) or introducing new home screen flows (home, new_flow).
No clear effect was seen for redesigns in pet adoption (adoption, redesign) or path selection (choose_path, redesign).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_screen: +8.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: -0.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, redesign: +2.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, redesign: -6.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, new_flow: +0.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +1.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 72.8%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 21.3%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Sync Benefit Callout: Adds a prominent hint text above sign-in options clarifying that signing in preserves pet progress and prevents lost pets across reinstalls. (why: 8 support emails mentioned pets missing or reset after signing in again, and sign-in drops 27.1% of users.)
1: [home, new_screen] Pet Arrival Preparation Screen: Inserts a new 'new_pet_prep' screen right before the waiting screen showing an animation of the pet crate opening. (why: The home waiting stage has a long median time of 201s and mean of 2336s; adding visual setup momentum reduces drop-off.)
2: [finish, redesign] Desktop Tray & Pet Control Overview Redesign: Redesigns the home_intro screen using a spotlight layout with explicit visual callouts for desktop tray controls and hide/show shortcuts. (why: Finish step drop-off is high (64.8% conversion) with 3 support emails reporting confusion on how to control or hide the pet.)
3: [choose_path, layout] Path Selection Grid Layout: Changes the layout of choose_path screen to a grid format displaying ready-made vs custom creation options side-by-side. (why: choose_path has a high mean duration of 514s; presenting options cleanly reduces decision friction.)
4: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Daily Routine Preferences Screen: Adds a new screen 'new_routine_setup' during adoption to let users pick active work hours for their pet. (why: Lessons showed that adding a new screen during pet adoption was helpful and won.)
5: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Progress & Care Tips: Adds an animated progress indicator and rotating care tips to the waiting screen while the pet model generates. (why: The waiting screen has a mean time of 2336s, leading to drop-off if users feel stuck.)
6: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Interaction Gesture Flow: Introduces a new interactive onboarding step 'new_gesture_guide' on home_intro demonstrating click-and-drag pet physics. (why: Multiple support emails cited confusion about controlling desktop features after setup and finish conversion is only 64.8%.)
7: [choose_path, copy] Onboarding Story Purpose Clarity: Updates headline and body on the story screen to explain immediately that the pet will live on top of desktop windows. (why: Mean time on choose_path/story is 514s and 3 support tickets mention pets not displaying or users failing to find desktop pets.)
8: [sign_in, layout] Centered Sign-In Account Reassurance Layout: Changes the sign_in screen layout to centered with a friendly mascot reassuring returning and new users. (why: Sign-in step drops 27.1% of users with an 8-email support cluster around account sync issues.)
